reason: This appears to be a transaction-stack refactor, not a narrow local fix: it changes where txn options are applied across core session/sessionctx/store provider paths, with related DDL and GC worker call sites. A change in when or how txn options are set can affect transaction/session correctness, isolation, and consistency semantics across many flows, so it is central and risky enough for a blocker/high-severity deep review.
